network: The owner's laptop over the internet, outside us-west-2, assumption A25. Transfer times include that path.

endpoints.payer: Bucket owners. Every request was unsigned, so no requester was charged. A requester-pays bucket refuses unsigned requests.

selection_rule: For each tile and each month of 2025, list every product scene, keep those holding all 14 objects of finding 26, and take the earliest sensing time. Among products with that sensing time, take the latest generation time. The rule uses names only.
join_rule: Search Earth Search for the tile and day. Match tile, platform, and sensing start from the product names, Collection 1 first, then the older collection, finding 28. Prefer an item of the same processing baseline. Among several, take the latest created time.

tolerances.R1_grid: The product window and the joined Level-2A scene classification window must share the CRS, a 20 m pixel, and a zero-pixel origin offset, from the file headers, within 1e-06 pixel. A scene that fails keeps its band counts and is left out of every comparison with the scene classification.
tolerances.R2_flags: A flags value decodes when it is an exact multiple of 10000. Zero tolerance. Other values are counted as not_multiple and never rounded.
tolerances.R3_masking: A band pixel is no_data when it holds -32768. It is also processor_masked when the joined scene classification holds data there, any class but 0. Without a usable join, processor_masked is null. A pixel class counts as masked by the processor when, pooled over scenes and lakes, the processor_masked share of its joined pixels exceeds 1% in any band. Every processor_masked pixel is reported whatever the share.
tolerances.R4_values: A stored value is negative when it lies between -32768 and 0, exclusive, and above one when it exceeds 10000. Counted per band and class. No tolerance.
tolerances.R5_water: Water by NDWI means a delivered NDWI value above 0. Water by ACOLITE means the flag at exponent flag_exponent_swir is clear. Water by Level-2A means scene classification class 6. Agreement is counted where all three layers hold data. Descriptive, no tolerance.
tolerances.R6_cloud: Level-2A cloud means scene classification classes [8, 9, 10], and shadow class [3]. Such a pixel is unflagged when its decoded ACOLITE flag integer is 0. Descriptive, no tolerance. The scene classification is a land product with its own errors, claims Q1, Q4, and Q8.
tolerances.R7_ndwi_recompute: Diagnostic only. A stored NDWI value agrees with a band pair when it lies within half a unit of 10000 times (G - N) / (G + N), for some G and N within half a unit of the stored B03 and the stored B08 or B8A. Pixels whose G + N interval reaches zero are not comparable.

no_data_diagnostic.note: Counts per scene-lake record, class, and band. Equal counts do not prove the same pixels.

limitations: Five tiles and one scene per tile and month of 2025. Earlier years, whose inputs are mostly original Level-1C baselines, finding 27, are not sampled.
Scenes come from what the product holds. Its cloud screening removes most cloudy acquisitions, finding 27, so cloud counts describe the scenes it keeps.
The scene classification is a land product with its own errors, claims Q1, Q4, and Q8. Agreement with it is a comparison, not a validation.
Pixel classes come from NHD polygons, whose shorelines are not observations of a given date.
Counts are pixel observations, summed over scenes. Large lakes dominate pooled shares. The summary also splits by tile and by size class.
GDAL requests and bytes are byte ranges requested, from its debug log. Laptop over the internet, outside us-west-2, assumption A25. Times are not production estimates.
No pixel value is stored in the result. Only counts.
